title: Members of Parliament Salaries and Allowances Amendment Act 1993

sections.shortTitle: Members of Parliament Salaries and Allowances Amendment Act 1993
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III of 1993
ACT III of 1993
MEMBERS OF
PARLIAMENT (SALARIES AND ALLOWANCES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993
An Act further to
amend the Members of Parliament (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974
(Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 21st March, 1993)
The following Act of
Majilis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 18th
March, 1993, and is hereby published for general information:-
1. Short title and
commencement:------(1) This Act may be called the Members of Parliament
(Salaries and Allowances) (Amendment) Act, 1993.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Members of Parliament Salaries and Allowances Amendment Act 1993
sections.description:
Amendment of section 4, Act XXVII of 1974

ACT III of 1993
ACT III of 1993
MEMBERS OF
PARLIAMENT (SALARIES AND ALLOWANCES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993
An Act further to
amend the Members of Parliament (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974
(Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 21st March, 1993)
The following Act of
Majilis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 18th
March, 1993, and is hereby published for general information:-
2. Amendment of section 4, Act
XXVII of 1974:------In the Members of Parliament (Salaries and Allowances)
Act, 1974 (XXVII of 1974), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section
4, in subsection (1);
(a) for the words "one
hundred and fifty" the words "three hundred" shall be
substituted; and
(b) for the words "one
hundred" the words "two hundred" shall be substituted.

sections.shortTitle: Members of Parliament Salaries and Allowances Amendment Act 1993
sections.description:
Insertion of section 4B, Act XXVII of 1974

ACT III of 1993
ACT III of 1993
MEMBERS OF
PARLIAMENT (SALARIES AND ALLOWANCES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993
An Act further to
amend the Members of Parliament (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974
(Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 21st March, 1993)
The following Act of
Majilis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 18th
March, 1993, and is hereby published for general information:-
3. Insertion of section 4B,
Act XXVII of 1974:------In the said Act, after section 4A, the following
new section shall be inserted, namely:-
"4B. Sumptuary Allowance.--A
member shall receive sumptuary allowance at the rate of two thousand rupees per
mensem.".
